metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code (TypeScript) with a deployable entry point (Lambda handler in src/server.ts), IaC provisioning AWS resources (SAM template), and a single-service dependency manifest (package.json). Classified as application.
metadata.archetype_justification: DynamoDB table with CRUD operations (get, scan, put, update) detected. Write endpoints exist (upsertProduct, deleteProduct). No downstream service calls or message queue consumers. Classified as stateful-crud.

classification_consistency_check.reason: Score 3.02 yields Partial band (Pilot-Ready equivalent) but 3 High findings (INF-Q11, OPS-Q5, OPS-Q6) force Remediation Required tier. The service has excellent infrastructure choices (serverless, managed DB) but severe operational practice gaps (no CI/CD, no deployment strategy, no tests). The count-based tier is authoritative.

findings.title: Async Messaging and Streaming
findings.description: State-changing operations (upsertProduct, deleteProduct) do not emit events. No managed messaging infrastructure (SQS, SNS, EventBridge) is defined. The README identifies the missing audit event on delete as a gap.
findings.gap: State changes do not emit events. Other services cannot react to catalog changes without polling.
findings.recommendation: Add EventBridge integration to emit catalog.product.upserted and catalog.product.deleted events on state changes.

findings.title: Network Security
findings.description: Lambda executes in AWS-managed infrastructure without a custom VPC. DynamoDB access uses IAM-authenticated service endpoints. API Gateway with Cognito JWT provides the ingress boundary.
findings.gap: No VPC endpoint for DynamoDB. Traffic between Lambda and DynamoDB traverses AWS backbone but not a private VPC path.
findings.recommendation: Consider placing Lambda in a VPC with a DynamoDB Gateway endpoint for private network paths. Incremental hardening, not a critical gap for serverless.

findings.title: Backup and Recovery
findings.description: DynamoDB PITR is enabled providing continuous backups with 35-day restore window. This covers the primary data store.
findings.gap: No cross-region backup replication. No documented restore procedures or testing evidence.
findings.recommendation: Document and test PITR restore procedure. Consider cross-region backup for disaster recovery.

findings.title: Infrastructure as Code Coverage
findings.description: SAM template covers primary resources (Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway). No CloudWatch alarms, dashboards, or operational resources in IaC.
findings.gap: Missing operational/monitoring resources in IaC. Estimated 70-80% coverage.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms and dashboard to SAM template for Lambda errors, throttles, duration p99, and DynamoDB throttles.

findings.title: CI/CD Automation
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline configuration exists. No .github/workflows/, buildspec.yml, Jenkinsfile, or .gitlab-ci.yml found. All deployments are manual.
findings.gap: All deployments (application and infrastructure) are manual. No automated build, test, or deploy stages.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with stages: lint → build → test → deploy-staging → deploy-production. Use sam build && sam deploy in pipeline.

findings.title: Async vs Sync Communication
findings.description: This stateful-crud service is entirely synchronous. State changes do not emit async events for downstream consumption. The synchronous read path is appropriate for a CRUD API.
findings.gap: State mutations are not propagated asynchronously. Downstream services must poll or be tightly coupled via synchronous calls.
findings.recommendation: Emit domain events on state changes via EventBridge or SNS for loose coupling with downstream consumers.

findings.title: API Versioning Strategy
findings.description: GraphQL API at /graphql with no explicit versioning. No @deprecated annotations, no version headers, no schema evolution policy documented.
findings.gap: No explicit versioning strategy. Breaking schema changes would affect all clients simultaneously with no migration path.
findings.recommendation: Adopt schema evolution policy with @deprecated annotations and graphql-inspector in CI for breaking change detection.

findings.title: Service Discovery
findings.description: Service discoverable via API Gateway. DynamoDB uses SDK automatic resolution. TABLE env var provides logical naming. No explicit service registry or mesh.
findings.gap: No formal service registry or API catalog for service-to-service discovery.
findings.recommendation: For a standalone microservice, current pattern is adequate. Register in AWS Cloud Map if joining a larger microservices ecosystem.

findings.title: Encryption at Rest
findings.description: DynamoDB SSE enabled with AWS-managed encryption (AWS owned key). Provides encryption without customer key management.
findings.gap: Uses AWS-managed keys rather than customer-managed KMS keys. No explicit key rotation policy or key access audit.
findings.recommendation: Consider customer-managed KMS key for sensitive data if data classification warrants the additional operational overhead.

findings.title: Compute Hardening and Patching
findings.description: Lambda managed runtime (Node.js 20 arm64) provides automatic OS/runtime patching. No application dependency vulnerability scanning configured.
findings.gap: No automated dependency vulnerability scanning. npm packages not monitored for CVEs.
findings.recommendation: Configure Dependabot or Renovate for automated dependency update PRs. Run npm audit in development workflow.

findings.title: Application Security Pipeline
findings.description: No security scanning tools configured. No SAST, dependency scanning, or container scanning. No CI/CD pipeline exists to host security steps.
findings.gap: Complete absence of automated security validation. Vulnerable dependencies can reach production undetected.
findings.recommendation: Add npm audit --audit-level=high to build, configure Dependabot, add Semgrep or CodeGuru Reviewer for SAST.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing
findings.description: X-Ray tracing enabled on Lambda via Tracing: Active. Automatically instruments Lambda invocations and DynamoDB calls.
findings.gap: API Gateway HTTP API tracing not explicitly enabled. No OpenTelemetry SDK for custom spans.
findings.recommendation: Enable X-Ray on HTTP API Gateway. Add OpenTelemetry SDK for business-relevant trace spans.

findings.title: SLO Definitions
findings.description: No SLO definitions exist. No CloudWatch alarms on latency or error rates configured. No error budget tracking.
findings.gap: No formal SLO definitions for this API (latency, error rate, availability).
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs: latency p99 < 500ms, error rate < 0.1%, availability > 99.9%. Implement CloudWatch alarms.

findings.title: Business Metrics
findings.description: No custom business metrics published. Only default Lambda and DynamoDB infrastructure metrics available.
findings.gap: No visibility into business outcomes: product queries, upserts, deletes, catalog size.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch EMF metrics for ProductUpserted, ProductDeleted, ProductQueried counts and CatalogSize gauge.

findings.title: Anomaly Detection and Alerting
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms or anomaly detection configured. No alerting integration. Service degradation goes undetected.
findings.gap: Complete absence of proactive alerting. No error rate, latency, or throttle detection.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms for Lambda Errors, Duration p99, DynamoDB ThrottledRequests. Configure SNS for notifications.

findings.title: Deployment Strategy
findings.description: No deployment strategy beyond direct SAM deploy. No AutoPublishAlias, no DeploymentPreference, no CodeDeploy integration. Deployments replace the function immediately.
findings.gap: Failed deployments affect 100% of traffic immediately. No gradual rollout or automatic rollback.
findings.recommendation: Add AutoPublishAlias: live with DeploymentPreference: Canary10Percent5Minutes and alarm-based rollback.

findings.title: Integration Testing
findings.description: No test files exist. Vitest configured as dev dependency with test script but no *.test.ts or *.spec.ts files found.
findings.gap: Zero automated test coverage. Code changes cannot be validated automatically.
findings.recommendation: Write resolver unit tests with Vitest and aws-sdk-client-mock. Add integration tests against DynamoDB Local.

findings.title: Incident Response Automation
findings.description: No runbooks, incident response automation, or self-healing mechanisms found. No SSM Automation documents.
findings.gap: Incident response is entirely ad hoc. No documented procedures for common failures.
findings.recommendation: Create operational runbooks for DynamoDB throttling, elevated Lambda errors, and auth failures.

findings.title: Observability Ownership
findings.description: No observability ownership structure. No CODEOWNERS, no dashboards in IaC, no named alarm owners, no team attribution.
findings.gap: No clear ownership of monitoring and observability for this service.
findings.recommendation: Add CODEOWNERS file. Define CloudWatch dashboard in SAM template with team ownership tags.

findings.title: Resource Tagging Governance
findings.description: No tags defined on any AWS resource in the SAM template. DynamoDB, Lambda, and API Gateway have no cost/ownership/environment tags.
findings.gap: Cannot attribute costs, identify ownership, or differentiate environments via tags.
findings.recommendation: Add Tags to SAM Globals: Service, Team, Environment, CostCenter at minimum.

evaluations.title: Managed Compute
evaluations.reason: All compute on Lambda (serverless). No EC2 instances.

evaluations.title: Managed Databases
evaluations.reason: Fully managed DynamoDB with PAY_PER_REQUEST, SSE, and PITR.

evaluations.title: Workflow Orchestration
evaluations.reason: No multi-step workflows exist in this simple CRUD service. All operations are atomic single DynamoDB calls.

evaluations.title: API Entry Point
evaluations.reason: HTTP API Gateway with Cognito JWT authorizer providing managed entry point with auth and throttling.

evaluations.title: Auto-Scaling
evaluations.reason: Lambda inherent scaling + DynamoDB PAY_PER_REQUEST on-demand scaling.

evaluations.title: High Availability and Fault Isolation
evaluations.reason: Lambda, DynamoDB, and API Gateway all inherently multi-AZ.

evaluations.title: Programming Languages
evaluations.reason: TypeScript 5.4, Node.js 20, Apollo Server 4, AWS SDK v3 — all current generation.

evaluations.title: Monolith vs Microservices
evaluations.reason: Single independently deployable service with well-defined domain boundaries and clear interface.

evaluations.title: Long-Running Process Handling
evaluations.reason: All operations sub-second (DynamoDB CRUD with bounded pagination). No operations approach 30s.

evaluations.title: Unstructured Data Storage
evaluations.reason: Service stores structured product records only. No unstructured data in legacy storage.

evaluations.title: Unified Data Access Layer
evaluations.reason: Single DynamoDBDocument client via context. All access centralized in resolvers.

evaluations.title: Database Engine Version and EOL
evaluations.reason: DynamoDB is evergreen managed — no user-facing version, no EOL.

evaluations.title: Stored Procedures and Schema Complexity
evaluations.reason: DynamoDB has no stored procedures. All business logic in application layer.

evaluations.title: Audit Logging
evaluations.reason: Application-level IaC only. CloudTrail is an account-level concern belonging in foundation infrastructure repo.

evaluations.title: API Authentication
evaluations.reason: All endpoints require Cognito JWT via API Gateway DefaultAuthorizer. Mutations enforce catalog:write scope.

evaluations.title: Centralized Identity Integration
evaluations.reason: Cognito integration with JWT validation at API Gateway and scope extraction in resolvers.

evaluations.title: Secrets Management
evaluations.reason: Architecture eliminates secrets: IAM role for DynamoDB, Cognito JWT for auth. No credentials in code.
